matches.rationale: No finding identifies the omitted normalization term in Theorem 3.3. Pred_id 1 discusses a conflicting extra log-sum-exp term, which is a different scientific error.

No finding addresses the asymmetric hyperparameter tuning under the altered robustness training protocol. The existing findings cover equation errors, a citation misattribution, and a naming inconsistency, none of which match this experimental design issue.
No finding mentions the suspiciously high intra-class distance values for Logit Penalty in Table 2. The findings are unrelated to evidence integrity or Table 2.
No finding identifies the overclaimed causal attribution to the error-amplification term in the Introduction. The available findings do not cover this interpretive distortion.
No finding mentions the omitted low-shot performance analysis in the long-tailed classification section. The ethical omission is not captured by any of the three findings.
No finding discusses the uniformly small or equal standard deviations in Tables 4/5. The findings do not address this data integrity concern.
No finding identifies the incomplete gradient derivation that neglects the mean-logit dependency. The methodological inconsistency in Section 3.2 is not covered.
No finding addresses the over-generalized claims in the Conclusion about eliminating error amplification and superior transfer performance. The findings are elsewhere in the paper.
Pred_id 2 identifies a misattributed citation for MMSegmentation (ref [6]), which is not the fabricated reference [11] in Section 4.1.7. Different citations and locations.
No finding mentions the inconsistency between disabling CutMix/Mixup in Section 4.2.1 and their later use in appendices. The Lemma/Theorem naming issue (pred_id 3) is unrelated.
No finding points out the unqualified promotional claim in the Abstract. The findings do not cover rhetorical presentation manipulation.
